caption:
Women in India Inc leadership dropped from 20% to 16.7%. Business Today reported the setback on 10 September 2026.

A number that moves backwards is not a skills problem. Those women did not become less qualified. The pipeline did not forget how to produce competence.

The bottleneck sits after competence. It sits in the moment a point is made and the room waits to see whether it lands — and in who gets read as the authority when two people say the same thing.

Command is read before it is heard. Bearing. Tone. The pause you hold instead of filling. In 35 years of military command, Colonel Suhag watched authority get established in the first ten seconds and defended in the silence after.

That is trainable. It is not personality, and it is not confidence in the vague sense. It is a set of behaviours you can drill.

If your ideas only carry weight once someone else repeats them, the work is not more credentials. It is presence.

rationale: A stark two-number visual carries the backwards movement instantly, letting the caption spend its words on why the bottleneck sits after competence rather than re-explaining the statistic.
